name: notif-quest-optin
description: Verify the new featured weekly mission 'TURN ON NOTIFICATIONS' (wnotify) renders in the lobby missions panel with an ENABLE CTA, click it, and report the opt-in result

steps._comment: Dev server restarted after the code change; give the bundle time
Dismiss FTUE welcome modal if present
Open the PLAY tab where the missions panel lives

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.lb2-ft-news-row')).map(r => ({ title: r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-title')?.textContent.trim(), sub: r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-sub')?.textContent.trim(), cta: r.querySelector('.lb2-mission-cta')?.textContent.trim() || null })); const notif = document.querySelector('[data-testid=mission-enable-notifs]'); if (notif) notif.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return JSON.stringify({ rowCount: rows.length, rows, notifCtaPresent: !!notif, notifCtaLabel: notif?.textContent.trim() ?? null }); })()
steps.name: missions panel rows + wnotify CTA

steps._comment: The new CTA from the wnotify branch in DailyMissionsSection
Let the mutation + refreshMissions round-trip finish

steps.expression: (() => { const notif = document.querySelector('[data-testid=mission-enable-notifs]'); const row = notif?.closest('.lb2-ft-news-row'); if (row) row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return JSON.stringify({ ctaLabel: notif?.textContent.trim() ?? null, optedIn: notif?.textContent.includes('ON') ?? false, rowClass: row?.className ?? null, barWidth: row?.querySelector('.lb2-mission-bar-fill')?.style.width ?? null, claimVisible: !!row?.querySelector('.lb2-mission-claim-btn') })()
steps.name: wnotify CTA state after opt-in click
